questions.question: What did God promise about the latter glory of this temple?
options: The latter glory would be greater than the former, and he would give peace
The latter glory would be far less than the glory of the first house
Nothing more would be added to it in all the days to come
The house would be thrown down once again by the very hands of all its enemies
questions.answer: The latter glory would be greater than the former, and he would give peace

questions.question: Whom did God call his chosen 'signet ring' at the end of Haggai?
